tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.2.1 — Light Mode Default UX, Domain Roaming Desktop/Start Menu Shortcuts, and Reliable Process Launching
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.2.1 sets Light Mode as the default interface theme, resolves Windows Server domain folder redirection (placing shortcuts on redirected server desktops and Start menus), adds an explicit launch control on the Finish page, and launches via a detached process with proper working directory.
features: Light Mode Default: The application interface now opens in clean, crisp, high-contrast Light Mode by default, with one-click toggle to Dark Mode and persistent preference saving.

Domain Folder Redirection Support: Desktop and Start Menu shortcut creation now queries Windows Shell APIs to detect redirected server folders (e.g. \\newltcserver\userdata$\<user>\Desktop) and OneDrive paths.
Zero-Dependency Shortcut Engine: Uses native Windows Script Host (VBScript/cscript) rather than PowerShell, bypassing Group Policy and AppLocker restrictions on domain workstations.
Multi-Location Shortcut Placement: Shortcuts are installed in both redirected network desktop folders and local profile folders so the icon is always visible.
Reliable Post-Install App Launch: The installer now launches Ksav Kooker in a detached process with its native working directory, ensuring smooth launch upon clicking Finish.
Finish Page Launch Control: Added an explicit 'Launch Ksav Kooker now' checkbox right on the final installation wizard page.
In-App Update Checker (Help > Check for Updates... or Ctrl+U): Easily check for updates online or from local network shares.
100% User Data Isolation: All handwriting profiles, learned mistake rules, backups, and settings in %APPDATA% remain untouched during upgrades.
